title: Universal T3/T4 T04E Complete Turbocharger Kit (0.63 A/R Turbine, Intercooler, Wastegate & Piping)
description: Engineered as an all-in-one boost package for 1.5L to 3.0L mid-sized engines, this kit provides the essential hardware to reliably reach 250 to 350+ horsepower. The included T04E T3/T4 turbo features a 52.7mm inducer / 76mm exducer compressor wheel in a 0.50 A/R housing, moving roughly 35–40 lb/min of air at peak efficiency. Paired with a responsive 0.63 A/R T3 turbine housing, typical 1.8L to 2.5L engines will see full spool between 3,000 and 3,400 RPM while maintaining strong flow up to 14.5+ PSI. The 10-piece set includes a 27x7x2.5-inch front-mount intercooler, a 2.5-inch aluminum piping kit with couplers, a 38mm external wastegate, a 5-bolt downpipe adapter pipe, a Type-RS BOV, a manual boost controller, a 52mm boost gauge, and braided oil lines.
